key_idea: An n x n grid has min(d+1, 2n-1-d) cells on anti-diagonal d, so n works iff every distance's multiplicity fits its diagonal capacity.
sketch: Count occurrences of each distance (0..200). Try n=1,2,... and accept the first n where cnt[d] <= cap(d) with cap(d)=d+1 for d<=n-1, 2n-1-d for n<=d<=2n-2 and 0 beyond. Capacities are monotone in n so the first feasible n is the answer; n never exceeds ~201. O(n*200).
